briefings.title: Conversation with Pershing Square Capital Management Founder & CEO Bill Ackman | GIS Mexico City '26

people.name: Bill Ackman
people.role: Founder and CEO, Pershing Square Capital Management

briefings.tldr: Bill Ackman identifies the artificial intelligence revolution as the definitive economic driver of 2026–2028, remaining highly bullish on compute demand and capital sustainability while noting that high debt levels will keep interest rates persistently high.
